spec_evidence.checked: Cached stripe OAS snapshots (openapi/spec3.json): payment_intent_payment_method_options_us_bank_account lists preferred_settlement_speed in v2153 and drops it in v2154 with no successor property (token count 4 -> 0 across the whole spec; remaining props financial_connections, mandate_options, setup_future_usage, target_date, verification_method are unchanged). The three payment-intent request surfaces declare additionalProperties:false, so sending the property is rejected after the change. Fifty records are per-operation projections of this single schema removal across every endpoint that embeds a payment intent.

fix.migration_guide: payment_method_options.us_bank_account.preferred_settlement_speed was removed from the Stripe API with no successor (POST /v1/payment_intents/{intent}/confirm). Stop sending the property when creating/updating/confirming payment intents; the request schema rejects unknown properties. Settlement timing is now controlled by Stripe; if faster settlement matters to the business, that is an account-level conversation with Stripe, not a code path.
